hierarchical_A_seed_comparison.method: Resample the two training seeds, then paired complete games within cells, sharing game draws across seeds and matching noise variants. Equal weight per cell; the base control is shared. Two seeds provide limited information about training variability.

B41_vs_mean_A.method: Resample the two A seeds then paired complete games within each cell; share case draws between noise variants. The single B endpoint is fixed, with no estimate of B training-seed variability. Equal weight per cell and A seed. Undefined recheck ratios remain undefined, not zero.

A11.interpretation: Native token sequences match exactly; training and sampling log probabilities are not bit-identical. The backend cause is not established. The standard importance-sampling loss uses the recorded rollout log probabilities; no correction or experiment setting changed.

A23.interpretation: Native token sequences match exactly; training and sampling log probabilities are not bit-identical. The backend cause is not established. The standard importance-sampling loss uses the recorded rollout log probabilities; no correction or experiment setting changed.

examples.selection: Animals, p=0. Sort N ascending, then frozen index numerically ascending. Take the earliest case where A11 makes an ambiguous wrong guess with questions left and A23 never guesses. The raw control uses that same case, without an outcome filter.

Animals, p=0.10. Sort N ascending, then frozen index numerically ascending. Take the earliest case where A23 primary never guesses and its visible-budget rollout wins. Do not filter question text, target, EIG or game length.
